Method of Attack: Network scanning and information stealing to enumerate users and computers in a domain, gathering info on security, backup, and remote administration software, saving data in CSV and exfiltrating to C2 server
Interacting with Volume Shadow Copy Service (VSS) via API calls to steal files from shadow volume copies even when files are in use
Impacted Systems: Windows systems with Volume Shadow Copy Service
Networks with users and computers in domains
Attack Vector: Use of custom .NET tools deployed on compromised systems
Exfiltration of collected data to attackers' C2 server
